Operations Intern, Summer 2027
Harbor Freight Logistics

About the role
Harbor Freight Logistics is a mid-size logistics company. Our operations team keeps shipments moving. This is a paid 10-week summer internship.

Responsibilities
- Enter and verify shipment data in our tracking system
- Build and update Excel reports for the dispatch team
- Answer calls and emails from drivers and customers
- Help reconcile weekly invoices and flag mismatches
- Support the operations manager with daily scheduling

Required
- Currently enrolled in a college or university degree program
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
- Attention to detail
- Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred
- Experience with data entry
- Customer service experience
- Familiarity with inventory or logistics software

Application closes November 13 at 11:59 PM.
Applications reviewed on a rolling basis.
